invoke.reason: CloudAgent coding host is out of scope; Muse is not a jarvOS coding entrypoint.

startupHydration.reason: Muse runs on a separate computer with no session-start hook into the Muse host; automatic startup hydration would target the wrong lifecycle. Hydrate manually with the boot_jarvos prompt or the jarvos_hydrate tool.

declare.reason: No public Muse egress declaration is shipped.

receive.reason: jarvOS does not expose SendMessage or CloudAgent from this adapter.

validate.reason: jarvOS does not expose SendMessage or CloudAgent from this adapter.

receipt.reason: No public Muse lifecycle receipt bridge is declared.

read.evidence: read-only tools over HTTP; no raw vault file access from the Muse host

update.transport: jarvos_session_thread_write MCP tool for checkpoints; note edits go through the shared capture path

startupHook.reason: startupHydration is unsupported; there is no Muse startup hook on the vault host.

discover.transport: jarvos_shared_skills parity over vault-host remote MCP

invoke.evidence: raw-skill-bundle renderer; parity tracked per harness
invoke.transport: projected skill bundles installed into the Muse workspace skills directory

declare.reason: No public Muse authorization contract is shipped.

delivery.reason: Local owner configuration chooses a delivery surface; this public adapter does not configure one.

skillProjection.transport: jarvos_shared_skills parity over vault-host remote MCP
skillProjection.reason: Muse is a remote runtime on a separate computer. Skill bundles are projected over the owner channel and installed into the Muse workspace skills directory; parity is tracked with the jarvos_shared_skills MCP tool. Include/exclude decisions stay owner-approved.

hydration.command: After the remote connector is reachable, use the boot_jarvos prompt or call the jarvos_hydrate MCP tool at session start.
hydration.reason: startupHydration is unsupported because Muse is a separate computer from the canonical vault.

mcp.registration: On the VAULT HOST run modules/jarvos-agent-context/scripts/jarvos-mcp-http.js (authenticated Streamable HTTP in front of jarvos-mcp.js; Mcp-Session-Id per initialize). On the Muse host register only the reachable vault-host URL plus bearer token. Do not register stdio MCP on the Muse host disk; that hydrates the wrong machine. The token grants the full MCP surface, not only requiredTools.

unsupportedCapabilities.reason: Automatic session-start hydration is unsupported; Muse hydrates manually per session.
